name_en: Wani no sashimi — thin-sliced mountain shark eaten with ginger soy sauce
summary_ja: 中国地方の山間部で「ワニ」と呼ばれるサメを刺身にした一皿。海から遠い備北の地では日持ちするサメが重宝され、しょうがじょうゆで香りを抑えて食べる。秋祭りや正月に欠かせない一品と伝わる。
summary_en: In Hiroshima's mountainous Bihoku area, small shark—locally called "wani"—is sliced thin and eaten raw with ginger and soy sauce. Far from the coast, the long-keeping fish once filled the gap where fresh seafood rarely reached, and it is said to still appear at autumn festivals and New Year.
source_title: ワニの刺身 広島県

name_en: Koiwashi no sashimi — raw anchovy eaten with soy sauce and grated ginger
summary_ja: 広島湾のプランクトンで大きく育ったカタクチイワシを、しょうゆとおろししょうがで食べる呉の夏の味。鮮度が命の魚のため、水揚げが多い6〜8月にスーパーへ並ぶと家庭でさばいて食すと伝わる。
summary_en: Anchovy that grow plump on Hiroshima Bay's rich plankton are eaten raw with soy sauce and grated ginger, a summer taste of Kure. Freshness is everything with this fish, so households traditionally clean and slice it themselves as soon as it appears in shops during its June-to-August peak.
source_title: 小いわしの刺身 広島県
